seriesTitle: Guardian: The Lonely and Great God

episodes.title: What Kind of a Guardian Are You?
episodes.summary: A former human turned goblin is cursed to remain immortal and alone for hundreds of years. Ji Eun Tak, a girl who can see spirits, accidentally summons him, but she's not what he expected.

episodes.title: I'll Become Your Bride in 200 Years
episodes.summary: Eun Tak is happy when her life begins to change for the better, but then finds out Kim Shin has been lying to her.

episodes.title: I See the Sword
episodes.summary: Kim Shin pushes Eun Tak on whether she can see something about him nobody else can, but Eun Tak has other things on her mind.

episodes.title: I Won't Leave You
episodes.summary: Kim Shin meets with an old friend, and Eun Tak considers what her newfound responsibilities will mean for her future.

episodes.title: I Have to End My Life
episodes.summary: Eun Tak helps one of her visitors pass on to the other side, and Kim Shin makes new sleeping arrangements.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.summary: Kim Shin is still struggling to get Eun Tak to do what he needs her to do, while the Grim Reaper tries to act like a human.

episodes.title: I Think It's Your Face
episodes.summary: Eun Tak attempts to pull the sword out of Kim Shin's chest, but something holds her back. The Grim Reaper is thrown in jail.

episodes.title: You Gave Her That Fate
episodes.summary: The Grim Reaper and Duk Hwa must clean up after Kim Shin's reaction. Eun Tak takes her exams.

episodes.title: He'll Vanish Forever from This World to Another
episodes.summary: When Eun Tak learns of Kim Shin's fate, she tries to run away and avoid her own destiny. The Grim Reaper is at a loss with how to date.

episodes.title: Is She Really Your Sister?
episodes.summary: It's almost the new year, so Eun Tak asks Kim Shin to spend her first day as a 20-year old adult with her. The Grim Reaper struggles with the knowledge about Sunny's past.

episodes.title: The Deity Is So Cruel to You and Me
episodes.summary: The Grim Reaper confronts Sunny, as does Kim Shin. An old "friend" introduces himself to Eun Tak.

episodes.title: Forget About Me
episodes.summary: Sunny holds the key for the Grim Reaper to discover his past. Eun Tak begins college despite the threat on her life.

episodes.title: Protect Her
episodes.summary: Sunny, Kim Shin, and the Grim Reaper come to terms with their pasts.

episodes.title: Whom Have I Forgotten?
episodes.summary: The sword is out, and everything changes. Nine years pass, and we find out what has happened to everyone.

episodes.title: Will You Be My Bride?
episodes.summary: Eun Tak travels to Quebec to try and figure out why she can't remember a section of her past.

episodes.title: Goodbye and See You Again
episodes.summary: Both Sunny and Eun Tak inadvertently hurt their partners, who must come to terms with their decisions.
